paragraphs.text: The Official Urza's Destiny Game Guide is a guide to the cards in Urza's Destiny Magic: The Gathering set. It is a softcover paperback with 78 pages, written by Will McDermott , editor of The Duelist at the time. It was published by Wizards of the Coast on July 1, 1999.

A comprehensive guide to the newest card expansion for Magic: The Gathering, the world's most popular trading card game. Direct from Wizards of the Coast, a brand new strategy guide for the beginner and tournament player alike! This book reveals all the secrets players need to be competitive.
Foreword by Mark Rosewater , Lead Designer of Urza's Destiny
A story entitled " Phyrexian Autopsy ", by Will McDermott
